nodes.text: Let $f(n)$ be minimal such that there is a tournament (a complete directed graph) on $f(n)$ vertices such that every set of $n$ vertices is dominated by at least one other vertex. Estimate $f(n)$.

#902 : [Er63c] [Er82e] graph theory Schütte asked Erdős this in the early 1960s. It is easy to check that $f(1)=3$ and $f(2)=7$. Erdős [Er63c] proved\[2^{n+1}-1 \leq f(n) \ll n^22^n.\]Szekeres and Szekeres [SzSz65] proved that $f(3)=19$ and\[n2^n \ll f(n).\] Proof expositions (0) If you would like to contribute an exposition of a proof related to this problem, please message a moderator or leave your exposition as a comment.
